static_traits.name: 许贝妮
static_traits.social_status: 社交互动有限，仅与少数邻居偶尔交流
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness；过去not yet接受心理治疗；此前not yet出现类似心理问题

basic_info.main_problem: 因花园里自己种植的植物not断枯死而感到显著痛苦，并由此认定“我是一个很糟糕的人”。
basic_info.core_demands: I realize that the thought 'because a plant withered and died, I am a very terrible person' is affecting my mental health and my ability to enjoy hobbies, so I sought counseling.
growth_experiences: Widowed后长期Living alone在乡间，社交互动有限，仅有少数邻居且交流not多。
几个月前花园里的植物not yet按Anticipation生长并陆续枯死；她曾尝试调整浇水计划和更换植物类型仍not yet见效，由此开始将失败归因于自身，感到尴尬而not愿与邻居分享，压力逐渐增加并影响日常与园艺的乐趣。

core_beliefs: I am not good enough、做not好事情

special_situations.event: 在尝试照料花园时，看到植物再次枯死
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果连植物都养not好，就说明我作为一个人很糟糕、很not称职
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Frequently adjusts watering times and changes plant types, striving to prove they can keep plants alive well
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 为什么I cannot do anything well？I am just a failure/糟糕的人。

special_situations.event: 每当准备开始打理花园时都会感到显著压力
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果这次植物仍然not行，就再次证明我not行、我not值得
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 继续更改养护方案（浇水频率、选择not同植物），试图避免再次失败
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 这次恐怕也会失败，我可能什么都not行。

special_situations.event: 在Reflection植物枯死的原因时，忽略环境与外部因素
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 失败主要源自我个人的缺陷，若承认外因则without法解释我的“not称职”
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Focuses attention on self-blame; gives less consideration to factors such as soil and weather
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: It is all my fault，我就是not能把任何事情做好。

special_situations.event: 回顾园艺的结果时主要关注枯死的植物
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Only perfect care counts as good; any problem means I am very bad
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 过滤掉自己付出的努力与可能的客观条件，Reinforcement自我批评
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我做得一without是处，根本have not任何值得肯定的地方。

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be recognized as a capable person who can care for life and things
core_conflict.fear: 害怕被证明not够好、被评价为without能，从而失去自我价值与尊严
defense_goal: Gains a kind of 'sense of control' over failure through self-reproach and self-deprecation, avoiding seeking help from others in order to reduce embarrassment and the risk of being judged

object_relations.self_representation: not称职的失败者、without法妥善照看事物的人
object_relations.object_representation: Bystanders who may judge oneself and embarrass oneself (such as neighbors / others)

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When asked about the cause of a plant dying or facing plant-care failure again
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 将失败直接等同于自我价值缺失，认为“一切It is all my fault”，Reinforcement自我批评（移情：把外在问题内化为自我缺陷）
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 以自责的语气表达，用绝对化词语（如“我就是not行”），回避讨论环境因素或外部条件。

manifestations: Widowed后Living alone乡间、社交互动有限
因尴尬而not与邻居分享园艺困扰
在园艺失败中感到自我孤立
原本喜爱的园艺变成持续压力与挫败源
Overly binds individual worth to gardening success or failure, questioning self-meaning
outcomes: 体验到生活乐趣与意义感的下降

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or objects, or gives up seeking others to do something for them and instead does it to themselves; that is, the individual redirects energy originally intended outward toward themselves, corresponding to 'impulse'.
manifestations: 因尴尬not与邻居分享园艺问题
not主动寻求外部资源或支持，将压力转向自责与内耗

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Evaluates oneself with harsh labels (such as 'I am a terrible person')
Overly attributes failure to herself, limiting the room to explore external factors

positive_force: Has a certain willingness to act on the problem, has tried adjusting watering and changing plant types
愿意寻求心理咨询并开放地讨论想法
附近有少数邻居可作为潜在支持资源
negative_force: 自我标签化与过度概括，常以全局性negate评价自己
Personalizes the problem, ignoring environmental and external factors (such as soil, weather)
Living alone与社交受限带来的Loneliness与尴尬，降低了求助与资源链接的可能性

target_behavior.behavior: 在照料花园相关情境中出现显著的自责与Anxiety（负性自动思维与自我贬低）
antecedent: 看到或意识到植物再次枯死
target_behavior.core_reason: 将植物的成败过度绑定为个人价值的证明，并在Living alone与社交受限的背景下Reinforcement自我责备与羞愧感
target_behavior.function: Gains a 'sense of control' over failure through self-blame, while avoiding seeking help outwardly to reduce the risk of embarrassment and being judged
target_behavior.consequence: 兴趣与Decreased enjoyment of life，日常受影响，自信心进一步降低，问题从园艺蔓延到其他领域的Self-doubt
